comment: The support qualifier is shown on the serving relationship, although offered services use realisation relationships. It is unclear how mandatory or optional support is recorded consistently for both offered and consumed services.

public.text: The support qualifier is shown on the serving relationship, although offered services use realisation relationships. It is unclear how mandatory or optional support is recorded consistently for both offered and consumed services.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a single support-obligation property applicable to the actor-service association regardless of relationship direction, with formal validation rules.
